quotes.text: A chatbot answers questions, it sits there, waits for someone to ask it something, and then it generates a response that is useful for basic FAQs. But a digital twin does something completely different. A digital twin makes decisions.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: States the core distinction of the episode between answering questions and making decisions.

quotes.text: Your digital twin does not get access to data the user does not have, and it does not make decisions the user could not make.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Captures the no-new-privileges principle that makes agents trustworthy.

quotes.text: To be blunt, if you dump 10,000 documents into your knowledge source, you have made your agent worse.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A blunt, practical warning against ungoverned grounding data.

quotes.text: The division of labor here is very specific. Copilot Studio manages the conversational side and the decision logic while Logic Apps or Power Automate handle the high volume repetitive execution.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Summarizes the recommended hybrid reference architecture in one sentence.

quotes.text: Automation isn't about removing the human. It's about removing the friction while keeping the human in control.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable principle for avoiding over-automation.

takeaways: Chatbots contain cost by deflecting tickets, while digital twins codify expert decision logic and create value by reducing cycle time and errors across a workflow.

In Copilot Studio, logic lives in topics, tools and curated knowledge sources, with Logic Apps or Power Automate handling deterministic execution and the agent never getting more access than the user.
Follow the sequence instrument, model, simulate and operationalize, put governance and a measured baseline in place first, and start in advisory mode with one high-value workflow.
hook: Most organizations are building chatbots that answer questions but rarely change how work gets done. This episode is for Microsoft 365 and Copilot Studio architects and decision makers who want to codify expert logic into digital twins that diagnose, decide and deliver measurable business outcomes under proper governance.
